issue.title: Docs: explain mini-tasks and how they relate to TB4
issue.body:
## Goal
A short explanation, in the docs and in the Gym's mini-task view, of what Coder One mini-tasks are, how they're graded, how long they take, what they cost, and how they relate to Terminal-Bench 4.0 tasks: a fast local screen, not a benchmark result.

Source: episode 288 (`docs/transcripts/288.md`).
